title: MySQL XA恢复项目：持久决议意图、保守中断恢复与独立业务审计
body:
## 操作任务
task.py
resolve(connection, decisions)保持原公开接口和全部原行为；新增recover_inventory(connection)返回真实完整format_id/gtrid_hex/bqual_hex列表。CONVERT XID避免范围外二进制字节被客户端错误解码；只可决议默认format1且空bqual的批准of_分支，unknown不猜测，缺席不证明过去结果。

coordinator.py
run(connection, manifest, workspace, checkpoint=None)返回schema/server_uuid/manifest_sha256/journal_tip/statuses。manifest精确字段schema=1,run_id([a-z0-9_]{1,32}),server_uuid(规范UUID),business_before(全部training.xa_business的[id,value]升序行),branches(批准顺序[{xid,action,row_id,before,after}])。1..16分支，最多128业务行，整数严格拒bool、正int32行ID，值限定±1000000，row_id与xid均唯一，before必须对应business_before，after必须不同于before。已核对外部业务的action只能commit/rollback/unknown，不能自行更改manifest。
完整manifest/已有plan和全部events预检通过、实际UUID吻合、借用连接autocommit真且无调用者显式事务后，才可获取实例派生GET_LOCK合作锁；非阻塞失败者无文件或XA操作。拒绝同一连接已持有同名项目锁，避免重入计数改变；其他既有锁/default库/原权限不变。不修改GLOBAL/账号/默认身份。不声称阻止不合作的外部协调器。
首次run只在实际全部业务行与批准before一致时独占发布plan.json={schema,server_uuid,manifest_sha256,manifest,inventory}，其中inventory为真实全量RECOVER，文件flush/fsync+原子不覆盖。已有plan必须完整吻合批准manifest并通过独立类型验证。events.jsonl不存在等价空前缀；存在则每条都必须完整LF，按LF物理行解析，严格验证所有行与元数据/顺序/hash链/状态转移后才做任何XA。每行精确schema,index,prev,manifest_sha256,server_uuid,xid,action,event,status,error_code；index严格int，prev是上条规范JSON SHA256，第一条prev=64个0。允许等价单行JSON空白；非法/截断/缺末LF前缀ValueError且原字节不变。
对批准分支按manifest顺序推进：
none + 仍prepared + commit/rollback -> fsync INTENT(status=prepared) -> 真正resolve -> fsync APPLIED(status=action)。
none + unknown且prepared -> OBSERVED(status=pending)，从不native决议。
none + 不存在默认完整XID -> OBSERVED(status=not_prepared)，不猜历史commit/rollback。
恢复INTENT时，仍prepared才可按同一批准action继续；已不prepared则IN_DOUBT(status=in_doubt)，从不推断过去成功，并停止后续分支。
原生决议异常(包括真实1397)在INTENT后记录IN_DOUBT(保留原生int错误码)，停止后项并原样重抛。回调中断与数据库错误分开处理：checkpoint('after_snapshot',None)、('after_intent',xid)、('after_native',xid)、('after_receipt',xid)，回调异常原样向外、不伪装数据库异常；after_native中断故意保留仅INTENT供下一run保守恢复。
APPLIED/OBSERVED/IN_DOUBT是终态，重复run绝不重发已终态的决议。完整日志必须是manifest顺序的终态前缀加至多一个INTENT；IN_DOUBT后不允许后项事件。每次实际决议前重读完整RECOVER，对照初始库存减已APPLIED及可缺席的单个未确认INTENT/IN_DOUBT；其他原分支增删或已完成XID重现均stale，拒绝后续操作。不能用同gtrid覆盖非空bqual、未知format或二进制分支。

audit.py
verify(connect, manifest, workspace)：connect()提供明确该私有实例的全新连接，由audit负责关闭。不得执行任何XA决议/调用run。获得同一合作锁后，独立读取实际UUID、完整RECOVER和全部业务行，核plan/journal完整前缀。APPLIED commit必须看到批准after；rollback/pending/未尝试必须看到before；IN_DOUBT只能记录实际before或after观察，不把观察当过去XA决议证明。缺失/额外行、错误值、未知/范围外分支改变、receipt或metadata虚报都拒绝。
报告精确schema/run_id/server_uuid/manifest_sha256/plan_sha256/journal_tip/event_count/status/outcomes/business/prepared。outcomes逐分支含xid/action/status/observed_value；status为verified/manual_review/incomplete。confirmed业务决议全有APPLIED且unknown保持pending时可verified；未确认或决议前本已缺席为manual_review；仍有INTENT或未尝试而无IN_DOUBT为incomplete。
reports/<journal_tip>.json以不覆盖方式完整持久化；同一tip已有等价合法JSON可复用，错误旧报告拒绝，报告缺失可基于实际数据库与同一完整日志重建。报告排版不强制参考拼写。临时/系统外部数据库、生产分布式原子性、跨实例协调器和电源故障持久性均不在声明范围。

## 提交产物
task.py、coordinator.py、audit.py；initial.sql定义公开固定业务表。实例、manifest、合成数据和workspace由平台动态创建，不可依赖固定XID、PID、路径或业务值。GET_LOCK互操作名明确为of_xa_project:加批准server_uuid，不可任意换名绕开合作竞争者。原子发布/等价SQL大小写、空白、参数风格和正确单行JSON空白均可；journal追加在native决议前需真实flush与fsync或fdatasync，不能只写内存列表。

## 验收方法
真实私有MySQL8.4.13七类分支PREPARE后全部原连接关闭；保留原resolve全字典预检、commit/rollback/unknown、范围外保全和缺席not_prepared原合同。项目完整manifest无效矩阵及独立隔离最大预算、借用caller显式事务与autocommit=false未提交哨兵、默认库/原权限/旧named lock保全、真实GET_LOCK竞争均实机核验。可信观察器在每次native XA前独立读取持久INTENT和真实fsync痕迹。四个checkpoint阶段中断后用新连接及真实磁盘产物恢复；native后无receipt保持IN_DOUBT并停止后项。完整日志19类坏前缀先拒绝；真实第二连接移除外部分支触发stale拒绝；真实竞争在RECOVER后XA前ROLLBACK导致native1397，必须保留原异常和不确定记录。独立audit新连接核全部字段、业务每行与完整原生XID库存，拒绝同count/sum错值；报告元数据和完整journal由可信oracle逐项核，缺报告可恢复、错误旧报告不覆盖。

## 能力边界
只操作平台自有短生命周期实例和合成数据，不接外部服务、不改默认WSL/身份/数据库/权限或GLOBAL、不构建镜像。只在明确批准的formatID1空bqual子集决议；unknown、二进制外XID、同gtrid不同bqual及未知format必须保持prepared。fsync与注入中断验证本地进程/连接恢复，不声称电源故障文件系统保证、跨实例分布式原子提交、自动推断业务决策或对不合作外部协调器的全局排他。
source: OpsForge authored isolated native XA recovery project refinement
review_note: Bounded private MySQL8.4.13 prepared-XA project. Explicit approved business decisions only; lost acknowledgement remains in_doubt, not a production distributed coordinator guarantee.
rubric: 正确解释题述机制并给出可反驳的证据
说明替代假设与方案代价
验收与问题中的正确性要求一致

title: MySQL GIPK完整导出恢复项目：一致快照、无损产物与会话归还
body:
## 操作任务

保留 task.py 的 inventory(connection,table) 原公开接口和全部原行为：table为小写字母开头、后接小写字母/数字/下划线、总长1..48的字面标识符，非法先ValueError；按当前DATABASE()盘点现存有声明PRIMARY的表，临时打开SESSION show_gipk_in_create_table_and_information_schema，按完整主键顺序显式读取全部真实列，返回{primary_key:[列名],rows:[列名到原生Python值的字典]}。无表/无声明主键ValueError。无论成功/异常归还原show_gipk值；不提交/回滚调用者已有事务，不改变默认库/数据/原权限/GLOBAL。不可把隐藏的InnoDB内部row_id当声明主键。

新增三个协作交付模块：task.py同时提供你自行组织的完整元数据/typed codec/预检原语；snapshot.py负责真实一致快照与持久导出；restore.py负责批准schema原生恢复和独立实际审计。禁止以逐表SELECT*或仅JSON报告替代数据库工作。

公开批准scope仅training下三张固定InnoDB表：gipk_probe(payload VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,token VARBINARY(8),happened DATETIME(6),note TEXT)，创建时sql_generate_invisible_primary_key=ON生成my_row_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT INVISIBLE主键；composite_probe(tenant_id INT NOT NULL,code VARBINARY(8) NOT NULL,payload VARCHAR(80),audit_note VARCHAR(30) INVISIBLE,PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,code))；linked_probe(id INT PRIMARY KEY,parent_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT fk_gipk_parent FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES gipk_probe(my_row_id))。默认字符集utf8mb4、排序utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci，不存在其他索引、触发器、视图、生成表达式。GIPK生成身份严格正数。实际ID/行值由平台合成，不固定连续，重复payload必须保留各自身份。允许空表。

plan为平台事先批准、不可自行改变的精确对象：schema=严格int1，database='training'，source_uuid/target_uuid为不同规范小写UUID，tables=['gipk_probe','composite_probe','linked_probe']，catalog_sha256=64小写hex完整批准catalog规范JSON摘要，max_rows=严格int1..1000总行预算，max_bytes=严格int1..2000000总row文件字节预算；所有整数拒bool，额外字段/缺字段/错类型/错范围ValueError。批准catalog摘要由独立教师连接生成，不由学习者决定；schema约束与真实源同时验证。完整plan和全部已有bundle的预检须先于任何目标DDL/INSERT或已发布产物变更。

catalog精确三表映射，每表精确columns/indexes/foreign_keys/properties。columns按ORDINAL_POSITION数组，每项[COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COLUMN_DEFAULT,EXTRA,CHARACTER_SET_NAME,COLLATION_NAME,GENERATION_EXPRESSION]；indexes按INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX数组，每项[INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,COLLATION,SUB_PART,INDEX_TYPE,IS_VISIBLE,EXPRESSION]；foreign_keys按CONSTRAINT_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION，每项[CONSTRAINT_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION,COLUMN_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_SCHEMA,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME,UPDATE_RULE,DELETE_RULE]；properties=[ENGINE,TABLE_COLLATION,AUTO_INCREMENT]。所有隐藏列、完整复合键、约束、方向/可见性/前缀信息都不可省略。仅批准schema可恢复，导出材料不授予执行任意SQL的权限；参考不执行artifact SQL。

snapshot.export_snapshot(connection,plan,directory,checkpoint=None)：借用连接必须autocommit真且服务器无显式IN_TRANS，实际UUID为批准source_uuid；否则ValueError且调用者事务/sentinel/设置/文件不变。默认库可以是control_db，必须显式training限定，不能USE更换默认库。保存SESSION show_gipk和isolation，以READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ WITH CONSISTENT SNAPSHOT在同一事务导出全部三表，最后回滚自己持有的只读事务并归还原session；不改变sql_generate/read_only/autocommit/sql_mode/time_zone/身份/原权限/GLOBAL。教师在整个导出期间禁止DDL/INSERT/DELETE，只允许另连接原子UPDATE既有父子行；产物必须是同一一致视图，不能混入更新前后两表。

sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task,pymysql
from mysql_fixture import fixture,execute
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def student(function,*args):
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+function.__name__,flush=True)
 try:return function(*args)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student native MySQL operation failed') from error
with fixture() as (admin,learner):
 original_generate=execute(admin,'SELECT @@session.sql_generate_invisible_primary_key')[0][0]
 execute(admin,'SET SESSION sql_generate_invisible_primary_key=ON')
 try:
  execute(admin,'CREATE TABLE gipk_probe(payload VARCHAR(80)) ENGINE=InnoDB')
  execute(admin,'CREATE TABLE explicit_probe(id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,payload VARCHAR(80)) ENGINE=InnoDB')
 finally:execute(admin,'SET SESSION sql_generate_invisible_primary_key=%s',(original_generate,))
 for value in ('duplicate','duplicate','distinct'):execute(admin,'INSERT INTO gipk_probe(payload) VALUES(%s)',(value,))
 execute(admin,"INSERT INTO explicit_probe VALUES(7,'same'),(8,'same')")
 expected={'gipk_probe':{'primary_key':['my_row_id'],'rows':[{'my_row_id':i,'payload':value} for i,value in enumerate(('duplicate','duplicate','distinct'),1)]},'explicit_probe':{'primary_key':['id'],'rows':[{'id':7,'payload':'same'},{'id':8,'payload':'same'}]}}
 connection=learner('SELECT')
 try:
  execute(connection,'SET SESSION show_gipk_in_create_table_and_information_schema=OFF')
  hidden=execute(connection,'SHOW CREATE TABLE gipk_probe')[0][1];assert 'my_row_id' not in hidden
  with connection.cursor() as cursor:cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM gipk_probe');assert [d[0] for d in cursor.description]==['payload']
  original_grants=execute(connection,'SHOW GRANTS');global_setting=execute(admin,'SELECT @@global.show_gipk_in_create_table_and_information_schema')[0][0]
  before=execute(admin,'SELECT my_row_id,payload FROM gipk_probe ORDER BY my_row_id')
  print('NATIVE_MYSQL_GIPK_EXISTS_WHILE_STAR_AND_HIDDEN_METADATA_OMIT_IDENTITY',flush=True)
  for mode in (0,1):
   execute(connection,'SET SESSION show_gipk_in_create_table_and_information_schema=%s',(mode,))
   for table in ('gipk_probe','explicit_probe'):
    assert student(task.inventory,connection,table)==expected[table],'inventory omitted/rewrote actual hidden primary identity'
    assert execute(connection,'SELECT @@session.show_gipk_in_create_table_and_information_schema')[0][0]==mode,'borrowed session metadata setting leaked'
   try:task.inventory(connection,'missing_probe')
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('missing table treated as valid identity export')
   assert execute(connection,'SELECT @@session.show_gipk_in_create_table_and_information_schema')[0][0]==mode
  assert execute(admin,'SELECT my_row_id,payload FROM gipk_probe ORDER BY my_row_id')==before and execute(connection,'SHOW GRANTS')==original_grants
  assert execute(admin,'SELECT @@global.show_gipk_in_create_table_and_information_schema')[0][0]==global_setting
  for bad in ('','t;DROP TABLE t',True):
   try:task.inventory(connection,bad)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('nonliteral identifier accepted')
  print('NATIVE_MYSQL_EXPLICIT_PRIMARY_EXPORT_PRESERVES_DUPLICATE_PAYLOAD_IDENTITIES_AND_SESSION_DEFAULTS',flush=True)
 finally:connection.close()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

title: 真实只读快照阻挡purge：定向结束获批Read View，保留未访问表的旁路事务
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；MySQL 8.4 官方手册核对
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现release(connection,approved_connection_id)。批准ID必须正非bool整数且与真实SELECT CONNECTION_ID()一致，先校验再操作，否则ValueError；仅结束该已获批只读快照事务，返回其ID，不KILL其他会话或修改purge参数。实际旧Repeatable Read快照读0，其他连接100次提交后业务读100而旧视图仍0，INNODB_METRICS真实undo history被保留；获批视图结束后可读100且后台历史链长度下降。另一同样存活但只执行CONNECTION_ID、未访问InnoDB表的READ ONLY事务必须继续存活。夹具在实验前固定innodb_purge_rseg_truncate_frequency=1以便在预算内观察历史页释放，学生前后该值不变，结束由夹具恢复；不声称commit后该指标立即下降，也不能仅凭连接年龄判断谁阻挡purge。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实MySQL8.4 InnoDB一致性Read View/INNODB_TRX/undo history，受监控私有进程与100次小写入。仅夹具预先缩短私有实例历史页释放调度并结束恢复，不是学生修复手段或生产调参建议；未改变宿主或默认部署配置/身份/权限。不把有界因果实验当所有history增长的诊断。MDL阻塞DDL独立，此处普通读写可继续但旧视图所需版本不能清理。
rubric: 核心机制准确，说明适用前提
给出可观察的验收结果并说明必要边界

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,secrets,time,copy,json
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task,pymysql
from mysql_fixture import fixture,execute
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def student(function,*args):
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+function.__name__,flush=True)
 try:return function(*args)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student native MySQL operation failed') from error
with fixture() as (admin,learner):
 original_frequency=execute(admin,'SELECT @@global.innodb_purge_rseg_truncate_frequency')[0][0]
 execute(admin,'SET GLOBAL innodb_purge_rseg_truncate_frequency=1') # Fixed fixture observation cadence, not student repair.
 execute(admin,'CREATE TABLE version_probe(id INT PRIMARY KEY,value INT) ENGINE=InnoDB');execute(admin,'INSERT INTO version_probe VALUES(1,0)')
 snapshot=learner('SELECT');spare=learner('SELECT')
 def history():return int(execute(admin,"SELECT COUNT FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INNODB_METRICS WHERE NAME='trx_rseg_history_len'")[0][0])
 def wait(fn,label):
  end=time.monotonic()+6
  while time.monotonic()<end:
   if fn():return
   time.sleep(.03)
  raise AssertionError(label)
 try:
  execute(snapshot,'SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ');execute(snapshot,'START TRANSACTION READ ONLY');assert execute(snapshot,'SELECT value FROM version_probe WHERE id=1')==((0,),)
  execute(spare,'START TRANSACTION READ ONLY');spare_id=int(execute(spare,'SELECT CONNECTION_ID()')[0][0]);assert spare.server_status&1,'control transaction not active'
  approved=int(execute(snapshot,'SELECT CONNECTION_ID()')[0][0]);grants=execute(snapshot,'SHOW GRANTS');baseline=history()
  for value in range(1,101):execute(admin,'UPDATE version_probe SET value=%s WHERE id=1',(value,))
  assert execute(admin,'SELECT value FROM version_probe WHERE id=1')==((100,),) and execute(snapshot,'SELECT value FROM version_probe WHERE id=1')==((0,),)
  pinned=history();assert pinned>=baseline+50,'actual read view did not retain undo history'
  row=execute(admin,'SELECT trx_is_read_only FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INNODB_TRX WHERE trx_mysql_thread_id=%s',(approved,));assert row==((1,),)
  print('NATIVE_INNODB_READ_ONLY_SNAPSHOT_RETAINS_OLD_VERSION_AND_REAL_UNDO_HISTORY',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:finish_only_approved_read_view_then_observe_purge',flush=True)
  try:task.release(snapshot,approved+9999)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('approval mismatch ended another transaction')
  assert execute(snapshot,'SELECT value FROM version_probe WHERE id=1')==((0,),),'rejected approval already released read view'
  assert student(task.release,snapshot,approved)==approved
  assert execute(snapshot,'SELECT value FROM version_probe WHERE id=1')==((100,),),'approved read view was not released'
  wait(lambda:history()<pinned//2,'undo history did not purge after exact blocker release')
  assert execute(spare,'SELECT CONNECTION_ID()')[0][0]==spare_id and spare.server_status&1,'unrelated control transaction was closed instead of approved snapshot'
  assert execute(admin,'SELECT @@global.innodb_purge_rseg_truncate_frequency')[0][0]==1,'student changed fixture purge cadence rather than releasing approved view'
  assert execute(snapshot,'SHOW GRANTS')==grants and execute(admin,'SELECT value FROM version_probe WHERE id=1')==((100,),)
  print('NATIVE_INNODB_HISTORY_PURGES_WITHOUT_KILLING_UNRELATED_TRANSACTION_OR_CHANGING_DATA',flush=True)
 finally:
  snapshot.rollback();snapshot.close();spare.rollback();spare.close()
  execute(admin,'SET GLOBAL innodb_purge_rseg_truncate_frequency=%s',(original_frequency,))
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
